changes.finding: The existing reference distinguished Allocation and Pinned but led with a heap-first ordered cause list and omitted the combined reason emitted by OpenJDK25.
changes.correction: Follow every reported reason, including Allocation / Pinned, and correlate process/GC event and separate failure counters; retain allocation-pressure investigation after a pinning fix until follow-up evidence resolves it.
changes.consequence: Prevents collapsing pinning into a heap-sizing issue or treating two simultaneous reasons as mutually exclusive.

changes.finding: The old one-line JNI critical-section advice did not say how to identify the active native path or behave when the implementation was unavailable.

changes.consequence: Directs the next discriminator toward the mechanism actually responsible rather than guessing a library or flag.

sources.supports: G1YoungGCTraceTime name construction can emit Allocation, Pinned, or Allocation / Pinned; pinned collection-set regions are registered as failed.
do_copy_to_survivor_space distinguishes pinned primitive arrays from destination-allocation failure; failure handling records the cause.
RestoreEvacuationFailedRegions exposes Evacuation Failed Regions, Pinned Regions and Allocation Failed Regions counters.
GetPrimitiveArrayCritical pins the object and its release unpins; critical String paths also show why actual implementation/path matters.
Critical region should be short; restrictions include blocking to await another Java thread. The skill's cleanup/evidence recommendations are engineering consequences of this resource boundary.
finalize_old_part gates marking candidates with in_mixed_phase but selects retained candidates separately; debug cset logging identifies those selections.
